resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Japanese source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Japanese pass identified 25 actionable formula, terminology, grammar, technical-clarity, and SI-unit defects across electrical, circuit, TCR, trigonometric, thermal, and unit content; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Japanese human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating summary said current changes resistance into heat instead of electrical energy.
evidence: The previous summary used 電流が抵抗を熱に変える.
findings.resolution: Changed it to current converting electrical energy into heat.

findings.summary: The coil setup used an unnatural verb for carrying current.
evidence: The previous setup said the coil transmits 3 A.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as 3 A flowing through the 0.8 Ω coil.

findings.summary: The practical-heating paragraph used an English-derived headroom term and less natural wording.
evidence: The previous paragraph used ヘッドルーム and mixed the caution structure.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with Japanese safety-margin wording and clearer battery limits.

findings.summary: The current-law heading mistranslated law as a current state.
evidence: The previous title was キルヒホッフの現在法則.
findings.resolution: Changed it to キルヒホッフの電流則.

findings.summary: The KCL formula omitted standard spacing.
evidence: The previous expression was ΣI = 0.
findings.resolution: Restored Σ I = 0.

findings.summary: The KCL explanation used current-direction and current-flow wording that was unnatural in Japanese.
evidence: The previous paragraph used 現在の方向 and 伝送 for electrical current.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with 電流の向き and natural flow wording.

findings.summary: The series-resistance example localized the protected total-resistance variable.
evidence: The previous expression was R_合計 = 0.40 Ω.
findings.resolution: Restored R_total = 0.40 Ω.

findings.summary: The KVL formula omitted standard spacing.
evidence: The previous expression was ΣV = 0.
findings.resolution: Restored Σ V = 0.

findings.summary: The KVL example omitted spacing between the voltage value and unit.
evidence: The previous expression was +8.0V - V_1 - V_2 = 0.
findings.resolution: Restored +8.0 V - V_1 - V_2 = 0.

findings.summary: The voltage-law paragraph mistranslated sign as a physical sign/indication.
evidence: The previous paragraph used 兆候 instead of 符号.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with natural loop-direction, polarity, and sign terminology.

findings.summary: The series-cell formula localized the protected series note.
evidence: The previous expression ended with (シリーズ).
findings.resolution: Restored the protected (series) notation.

findings.summary: The lithium-ion charging warning used awkward wording for charging cells in series.
evidence: The previous bullet used 直列リチウムイオン充電.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as charging lithium-ion cells in series with per-cell monitoring and balancing/protection.

findings.summary: The TCR coefficient units omitted standard spacing around division.
evidence: The previous bullet used 1/°C and ppm/°C.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 1 / °C and ppm / °C.

findings.summary: The temperature-difference instruction said temperatures rather than temperature differences.
evidence: The previous bullet began with 温度では.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the correct wording for T - T_0 temperature differences.

findings.summary: The TCR example contained a corrupted ohm symbol.
evidence: The previous setup rendered 1.00 Ω as 1.00 :9.
findings.resolution: Restored the 1.00 Ω notation.

findings.summary: The right-triangle explanation had incorrect side descriptions and awkward punctuation.
evidence: The previous paragraph confused adjacent/opposite relationships and included an English-style fragment.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the definitions and SOH-CAH-TOA mnemonic in natural Japanese.

findings.summary: The worked formula localized the protected side label.
evidence: The previous expression used Japanese labels inside the formula.
findings.resolution: Restored opposite = 10 × sin(30°) = 5 cm.

findings.summary: The second worked formula localized the protected side label.
evidence: The previous expression used Japanese labels inside the formula.
findings.resolution: Restored adjacent = 10 × cos(30°) ≈ 8.66 cm.

findings.summary: The identity heading translated identities as personal identities.
evidence: The previous title was 波形と役立つ正体.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 波形と恒等式.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity conclusion said more heaters were needed instead of more energy.
evidence: The previous sentence ended with さらに多くのヒーターが必要.
findings.resolution: Corrected it to say that more energy is required because of heat loss.

findings.summary: The object/material heading relied on awkward loanwords.
evidence: The previous title was オブジェクトとマテリアル.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 物体と材料.

findings.summary: The SI length row used an English-derived spelling and a localized unit name as the symbol.
evidence: The previous row was 長さ / メーター / メートル.
findings.resolution: Corrected it to 長さ / メートル / m.

findings.summary: The SI mass quantity was mistranslated as misa.
evidence: The previous row used ミサ instead of 質量.
findings.resolution: Changed it to 質量.

findings.summary: The candela symbol used uppercase letters.
evidence: The previous row used CD instead of cd.
findings.resolution: Corrected the symbol to cd.

findings.summary: The milli prefix used the Japanese word for metre as its symbol.
evidence: The previous row used メートル for 10^-3.
findings.resolution: Corrected the symbol to m.
